title: New cost center
description: A cost center in the shared SAP Business One (called a profit center in the Service Layer: ProfitCenters). The code is generated when MDM publishes it.
x-sap-note: In SAP Business One, adding a cost center also creates a matching distribution rule automatically.

CenterName.title: Cost center name
CenterName.description: Up to 30 characters, for example: QTG VN Service Hanoi.

EffectiveFrom.title: Effective from
EffectiveFrom.description: The first day this cost center can be used.

InWhichDimension.title: Reporting dimension
InWhichDimension.description: Which of SAP's five cost-tracking dimensions this cost center reports under. If you do not choose, dimension 1 is used.

purpose.title: What is this cost center for?
